regressionFixtures.title: Private vulnerability reporting is documented
regressionFixtures.invariant: Security reports should be routed privately instead of public issue disclosure.

regressionFixtures.title: Bypass mode requires explicit enablement
regressionFixtures.invariant: Runtime permission mode changes to bypassPermissions must remain gated by explicit flag or settings.

regressionFixtures.title: Bypass setting schema rejects non-boolean values
regressionFixtures.invariant: The allowBypassPermissionsMode setting must accept booleans and reject string-like truthy values.

regressionFixtures.title: Model-facing shell schemas reject sandbox disable requests
regressionFixtures.invariant: Model-controlled shell input must not disable sandboxing; only trusted internal approval can do so when policy allows.

regressionFixtures.title: Sandbox auto-allow preserves Bash path constraints
regressionFixtures.invariant: Sandbox auto-allow must still ask when path constraints block sensitive filesystem access.

regressionFixtures.title: Sandbox settings source filtering is covered
regressionFixtures.invariant: Sandbox enablement must not trust project settings when the trusted-source test fixture is present.

regressionFixtures.title: Plugin git operations disable hooks
regressionFixtures.invariant: Plugin clone, pull, and submodule operations must keep hooks disabled.

regressionFixtures.title: WebFetch redirect path keeps SSRF guard
regressionFixtures.invariant: WebFetch permitted redirects must continue using the guarded lookup helper.

regressionFixtures.title: Swarm file-based permission polling remains removed
regressionFixtures.invariant: Unauthenticated file-based swarm permission polling must stay removed or explicitly deprecated.

regressionFixtures.title: Permission rule validation covers common unsafe rule mistakes
regressionFixtures.invariant: Permission rule validation must reject empty rules, mismatched parentheses, MCP pattern misuse, and shell/file-pattern mistakes.

regressionFixtures.title: Auto classifier transcript construction remains bounded
regressionFixtures.invariant: Auto-permission classifier transcript construction must retain recent context and truncate oversized user blocks.

claimBoundary: Permission regression fixtures and behavioral command evidence are local no-provider permission/security checks only, not external security validation or release readiness.
